logline: Ellis enters the hall as Mara crosses safely to the panel and opens the elevator.

central_goal.goal: reach a reserved elevator mark without intersecting Mara

beats.narrative_purpose: situation: demonstrate executable full-body hallway blocking

actions.performance_intent: walk out from apartment 3B and settle with weight
walk to the reserved elevator-right mark and stop cleanly
turn ninety degrees toward the elevator
point toward the elevator with torso and shoulder involvement, then recover
cross in front of Ellis at conversational distance without touching him
lean and look around Mara toward the elevator
walk to the reserved panel-operator mark and align to contact
press the panel with readable hand contact and recover
hold clear of the doorway while the elevator opens
full-body surprised weight shift toward the opening
turn from the panel and share the reveal

beats.blocking: Ellis enters from apartment 3B, walks to elevator-right and turns. Mara crosses in front at a reserved offset, Ellis looks around her, then Mara walks to the panel, presses it, and both react to the opening elevator.
beats.visible_action: The entire entrance, crossing, panel press, and elevator reveal remain visible in one wide shot.
beats.intended_reaction: Ellis leans around Mara and both transfer weight toward the opening elevator.
beats.performance_intent: readable with audio muted; clean starts, stops, turns, contact, and recovery

payoff: The elevator opens with all performers separated and the doorway visible.
notes: Bounded local performance-proof plan; no new story or LLM call.
